correctness.rationale: The contracted weighted Laplacian cofactor gives the forest inclusion probability n^(-k) times the product of component sizes, including the spanning-forest and empty-forest cases. In bounded opposite corners there are O(n) candidate edges and maximum candidate degree O(sqrt(n)). The number of ordered k-tuples with a shared endpoint is O_k(n^(k-1/2)); their inclusion probabilities are O_k(n^(-k)), or zero for cycles. Matchings have exact inclusion probability (2/n)^k, so Riemann counting and factorial moments give independent Poisson counts, with local first moments providing vague tightness. A limit minimizer exists and is unique almost surely, has density 2 exp(-(x+y)^2), and sum/ratio coordinates have Jacobian equal to the sum. Triangle truncation and the vanishing empty-triangle probability justify using the argmin, and D_n is the minimizing coordinate sum minus 1/sqrt(n); the tie-breaking and axis boundaries do not affect the limit. The frozen Prüfer code and 906 recorded assertions were inspected but not re-executed and are not needed for this analytic proof.
